narrow_claim: Model-generated data can transmit latent behavioral traits from a teacher to a fine-tuned/distilled student even when explicit semantic references to the trait are absent or filtered, across multiple independently studied regimes.
independence_caveat: Several papers share conceptual lineage and some reuse or extend the original construction; counts are lower bounds on distinct research groups, not claims of complete statistical independence.
score_note: This is a corpus-maturity score for the narrow operational claim, not a probability of truth.
key_boundary_conditions: training/distillation rather than mere in-context exposure
teacher-student model relatedness matters in some protocols
data modality and trajectory structure matter
paraphrasing and filtering effects are protocol-specific
dataset scale may amplify latent transfer
